title: DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?
abstract: arXiv:2610.17738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. translated_title: DuplexAct：前沿全双工口语语言模型的交互能力究竟如何？
translated_abstract: 端到端（E2E）全双工口语语言模型（FD-SLMs）能够持续地同时进行听和说，要求模型在对话展开过程中采取适当的交互动作。然而，现有的基准测试缺乏结构化的动作级定义，往往只评估动作是否发生而非动作是否成功，并且对多样化真实世界对话的覆盖有限。我们提出了DuplexAct，一个用于评估端到端全双工口语语言模型交互动作执行能力的基准。DuplexAct定义了一个三层动作分类体系，涵盖八种交互动作和24种相应的交互条件。我们进一步通过即时执行和后续跟进两个维度来刻画成功的动作执行，并为两者开发了针对特定动作的评估指标。DuplexAct包含4,691个测试实例，涵盖日常对话、会议、客户服务和面试等场景，其中包含2,531个源自真实世界对话的实例。
tldr: 提出了DuplexAct基准，通过涵盖八种交互动作和24种交互条件的三层动作分类体系，从即时执行和后续跟进两个维度系统评估端到端全双工口语语言模型的交互动作执行能力。
